items.prompt: We have RNA-seq from 110 kidney samples, TF motifs and a PPI network. We want one TF-gene regulatory network for the whole cohort.
Can DRAGON run with lambda1=0.4 and leave lambda2 unspecified while keeping lambda1 fixed?
items.evidence: workflows/dragon.yaml: Manual values must be supplied together.

items.prompt: Can BONOBO accept positional sample indices 0 and 2 in sample_names without translating them into actual sample IDs?
items.evidence: workflows/bonobo.yaml: sample_names are explicit IDs, never positional indices.
